beginner.title: Get started with Microsoft Intune
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Microsoft Intune, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Create and work cases
beginner.outcome: You can: log and resolve tickets or test cases
beginner.practice: Log and resolve three sample items

beginner.title: Knowledge and templates
beginner.outcome: You can: reuse answers and test steps
beginner.practice: Write two knowledge articles or reusable test steps

intermediate.title: Workflows and SLAs
intermediate.practice: Add an SLA and an escalation rule

intermediate.title: Reporting
intermediate.outcome: You can: report status and quality

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Microsoft Intune
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Microsoft Intune distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Microsoft Intune
expert.outcome: You can: use Microsoft Intune's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Integrate and govern
expert.outcome: You can: connect Microsoft Intune to the rest of the stack
expert.practice: Integrate Microsoft Intune with your issue tracker or CI

expert.title: Integrate Microsoft Intune into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Microsoft Intune with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Microsoft Intune to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Microsoft Intune well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Microsoft Intune" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
